gloss: downstream; lower reaches of a river

definitions.gloss: downstream; the lower reaches of a river
definitions.explanation: The part of a river toward its mouth, or the direction the water flows. Also used figuratively in business for the later stages of a supply chain, such as retail, as opposed to {川上|かわかみ} (raw materials and production).

examples.japanese: {川下|かわしも}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{流|なが}される→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{川下|かわしも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: We headed downstream in a boat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上流|じょうりゅう}→上流：15028_jouryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{汚水|おすい}→汚水：09654_osui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{川下|かわしも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{死|し}んだ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧。
examples.english: Because a factory upstream discharged waste water, fish died in the villages downstream.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {川下|かわしも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧: to head downstream
- {川下|かわしも}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{流|なが}される→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to be carried downstream
- {川下|かわしも}⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧: downstream industries

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{川上|かわかみ}→川上：25368_kawakami⟧: upstream — the opposite
- ⟦{下流|かりゅう}→下流：15029_karyuu⟧: lower reaches, downstream — a more technical word, also used for the lower social classes
